artworks.title: Sir Richard Spencer, Ambassador to Holland
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of a man visible from the chest up facing slightly to his right. He has a high forehead, bushy eyebrows, a prominent beard, and a mustache with short, neatly groomed hair. He wears formal attire with a wide, intricately patterned collar, a buttoned vest under a cloak-like outer garment. The background is a plain area encircled by a decorative oval border. The engraving contains text in Latin around the oval and a description in French at the bottom. No additional objects or adornments are visible.

artworks.title: Johannes A. Spina
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper torso, with his head turned slightly to the left. The man has a receding hairline, a mustache, and a short beard. He is wearing a buttoned garment with a high, ruffled collar. The background is plain and includes text above and below the portrait. Above the portrait, it reads "MORI ET VIVERE DNO," and below it states "IOHANNES A SPINA ANNO AETATIS 48."

artworks.title: Ambrosius Spinola
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.5 x 13.2 cm (7 5/16 x 5 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man in historical attire. The man is depicted in a formal pose, facing slightly to his left with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a pointed beard and mustache, styled in a distinguished manner, and short, wavy hair. The man is wearing a high lace collar and a buttoned doublet with detailed embroidery. There is no visible jewelry on him, and he is not holding any objects. The background consists of a simple, patterned design with inscriptions surrounding the oval frame. The engraving is set within a larger rectangular framework with additional text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Ambroise Spinola, Spanish General in the Low Countries
artworks.artist: Jan Muller after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, positioned slightly turned to his left as he looks directly forward. He has a trimmed beard and mustache, with short-cropped hair. The man is dressed in intricately designed armor with a ruffed collar made of lace around his neck. His right hand rests on the handle of a sword, while his left hand is by his side. He is also wearing a chain with a medallion hanging from his neck. In the background on the right, there is an elaborately decorated helmet with feathers on a table or pedestal, against a dark, textured surface.

artworks.title: Bartholomew and Christina Spranger
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated among various allegorical figures. The man has a short beard and curly hair, wearing a large ruff and richly adorned attire. Surrounding him are mythological and symbolic figures, including a skeletal figure, a winged cherub, and an elderly, bearded man with wings and a scythe. The background features intricate architectural embellishments and putti holding decorative garlands and objects. To the man's right is a portrait of a young woman in a decorative oval frame. The scene is filled with symbolic items, creating a baroque and complex composition.

artworks.title: Robert Stafford of Bradfield, Berks
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in an ornate garment with a wide decorative lace collar framed within an oval border. He is facing the viewer with a composed expression, showing his upper body and head. His facial features include a prominent nose, rounded cheeks, and medium-length, curly hair. There are decorative elements such as swirling patterns and ribbon-like scrollwork around the frame, as well as an emblem or coat of arms with heraldic symbols at the bottom. The background is grandiose and complements the formal and historical style of the portrait.

artworks.title: Johannes Stalpard
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Johan Dircksz van Nes
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper torso of a bearded man in a three-quarter position. The man has detailed facial features, including a prominent forehead, deep-set eyes, pronounced cheekbones, and a neatly groomed beard and mustache. He has short, combed-back hair and is dressed in a period outfit with a collared shirt and a jacket with buttons and intricate patterns. The man is surrounded by an oval frame with inscribed text inside. In the background of the frame, there is a dark textured surface. Additional text in an ornate script is located beneath the portrait.

artworks.title: Thomas Stapleton, D.D.
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a bust of a man, visible from the chest up, facing the viewer directly in a seated position. The man has distinct facial features with a prominent nose, pronounced cheekbones, and deep-set eyes. His expression is serious. He is wearing a large, flat hat and a fur-trimmed cloak. His hair appears short and is not prominently visible under his hat. Surrounding him is an oval frame with foliage patterns, and text along the border reading "THOMAS STAPLETONUS ANGLUS, AETAT. ANNO LXIII." The background is filled with intricate detailing.

artworks.title: Joannes Steinbergius
artworks.description: This is a historical drawing of a man showing his upper body. The man is positioned facing slightly towards his left, with a gaze directed at the viewer. He has medium-length wavy hair that frames his face, and facial features that include a prominent nose and a serious expression. His attire consists of a dark, formal-looking garment with a high collar and buttons down the front. The background is a simple engraved design with an oval frame surrounding the man's portrait. Text in Latin encircles the portrait within the frame, and additional text is present below the portrait. The detailed engraving suggests the drawing dates back to a historic period.

artworks.title: Stephen, King of England
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a regal figure seated from the waist up, facing right. The individual has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose, beard, and mustache. The figure wears a detailed helmet with decorative elements and ornate armor with scrollwork and a draped cloak. The person holds a spear in their right hand. The surroundings include a heraldic border with scrollwork, two crests, Latin inscriptions relating to titles, and a historical text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Stephen, King of England
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's upper body in profile facing right. He is in a regal pose with a slightly forward-facing head. The man has detailed facial features, including a strong nose, beard, and mustache. He wears a helmet with decorations and a plume, along with decorated armor, visible chainmail at the neck, and shoulder pieces. In his hand, he holds a large sword across his chest. The background shows an ornate archway with heraldic designs including lions and scrolls. The image is bordered by text mentioning "Stephanus Rex Angliae" on top along with Latin titles. Additional Latin text at the bottom provides historical context, rendered in calligraphic script.

artworks.title: Jan van der Straet, Artist
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's head-and-shoulders portrait in an oval decorative frame. The man has a stern expression, short beard, and mustache, and is wearing period attire with an elaborate collar. The frame includes inscriptions and intricate embellishments, such as female figures, cherubic children, scrolls, and musical instruments. Latin text is visible within cartouches on both sides of the portrait.

artworks.title: Thomas Wentworth, Comte de Strafford
artworks.artist: Charles Simonneau after Adriaen van der Werff after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image is of a man's upper body portrait. The man has curly hair, a moustache, and a well-groomed beard. He is in period armor with a decorative design. The engraving creates a circular frame around the portrait. Below this portrait is another engraved depiction of a bust. The frame is marked with the name "THOMAS WENTWORTH, EARL OF STRAFFORD." There is a sword-like hilt next to the drapery. The background is textured, suggesting depth without detailed scenery.

artworks.title: Thomas Wentworth, Earl of Strafford
artworks.artist: Charles Simonneau after Adriaen van der Werff after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of Thomas Wentworth from the chest upwards, looking over his right shoulder in a three-quarter view. He has a mustache, goatee, curly medium-length hair, and wears an elaborate armor with a high collar. The circular frame background has cloud-like patterns, and there is a plinth with a draped cloth, sculpted bust, and the inscription "Thomas Wentworth" below the portrait. The composition is in monochrome tones, typical of engravings.

artworks.title: Thomas Wentworth, Earl of Strafford
artworks.artist: Johann Reinhold Schildknecht after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man in half-length portrait, facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right. The man has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and a mustache. His hair is wavy and voluminous, falling in loose curls. He is depicted wearing what appears to be historical armor over a high-collared shirt. The background is plain, and there is text identifying the person as Thomas Wentworth below the portrait.

artworks.title: Thomas Wentworth, Earl of Strafford
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the waist up. He is in a seated position, turned slightly to his left and facing the viewer mostly in profile. The man has a strong facial structure with a pronounced nose and full lips, curly, medium-length hair, and a thick mustache. He wears ornate armor with intricate details and a white collar peeking out above the armor. The background consists of an oval frame with text and a plain, slightly textured surface. Below the oval is a rectangular section with printed text.

artworks.title: Thomas Wentworth, Earl of Strafford
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a portrait from the chest up, slightly turned to the side. He has a solemn expression, a prominent nose, high cheekbones, and a full moustache and goatee. His curly dark hair falls just above his shoulders. He wears a dark garment with a large, white collar and a chain with a medallion around his neck. The background shows a battlefield scene with soldiers and smoke under a cloudy sky, partially obscured by a curtain. The oval frame around the portrait identifies the man as Thomas, Comte de Strafford.

artworks.title: Thomas Wentworth, Earl of Strafford
artworks.description: This is an image of an engraved portrait depicting a man from the chest up. The man has curly hair, a prominent moustache, and distinctive facial features. He is wearing a dark, intricately patterned garment with a large white collar. The background is plain and the image is bordered by two concentric ovals with text at the bottom stating his name, "Thomas Wentworth," and additional details related to the portrait.

artworks.title: Joannes Sturmius
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait from the waist up of a man in a seated position, facing forward, with his body slightly turned to the left. The man has a long, flowing beard and his facial features include a high forehead, prominent eyebrows, deep-set eyes, and a solemn expression. His hair is short and appears to be combed back from his forehead. He is dressed in a detailed garment which appears to be a robe or cloak with an intricate pattern or embroidery on the collar. The background is a simple line shading. In front of him is a plate with text written in an old style font, labeled "IOANNES STURMIVS," followed by additional inscriptions.

artworks.title: Thomas Howard, First Earl of Suffolk
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man seated, facing forward. The man has a full beard and mustache, with curly hair under a wide-brimmed hat. He wears an Elizabethan-style outfit with a ruffled collar, patterned coat, and draped cape. The engraving is framed with a decorative cartouche featuring ribbons and cherubs. An emblem and banner surround the man's head. The background consists of detailed line work, enhancing the formal attire of the man.

artworks.title: Thomas Sutton, Founder of the Charterhouse
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a man from the chest up. The man is facing slightly to his right, with a calm expression. He has distinct facial features, short hair, a full beard, and a neatly trimmed mustache. He is wearing a garment with an elaborate collar typical of the Elizabethan era. The oval border includes an inscription: "THOMÆ SUTTON ARMIGER. FUNDATOR HOSPITALIS REGIS." The background has textured lines, and there is a small Latin inscription below the image. The portrait has a formal and historic presentation similar to engravings from previous centuries.

artworks.title: Thomas Sutton, Founder of the Charterhouse
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed portrait engraving an older man. The man has a full beard and a receding hairline. He is looking slightly to his left with a serious expression. He is wearing a formal garment with a fur collar and an elaborate ruff. The image is framed by an elliptical border with an inscription that reads, "THOMAE SUTTON ARMIGER FUNDATOR HOSPITALIS REGIS." In the background are intricate line engravings adding texture to the image. The paper appears aged with text visible on both sides.

artworks.title: Joannes Swicardus, Archbishop of Maguntino
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a middle-aged man with prominent facial features, short curly hair, and elaborate clothing typical of a historical or formal figure. He is framed within an oval surrounded by decorative elements, including cherubs and a coat of arms at the top center. Allegorical figures are positioned on either side of the oval, one holding a scepter and wearing a crown, the other holding a musical instrument. Below the portrait is a Latin inscription detailing the subject's titles. The background includes architectural elements and decorative motifs, enhancing the grand composition.

artworks.title: Jan Pieter Swelinck, Dutch Composer and Organist
artworks.description: The image is a half-length portrait of a man seated. He has a beard, mustache, short hair under a cap, and wears a garment with a large ruffled collar. The man's body is turned slightly to the left but his face is directed towards the viewer. His left hand is open and held up, while his right hand is partially visible below. The background is plain without additional elements. The portrait is detailed with shading and cross-hatching. There is a hand-written inscription and a signature below the portrait.
